title: Texture Sampling Parameters
summary: Official Derivative reference for texture sampling parameter groups exposed where a TOP is sampled in materials or shaders, including extend, filter, anisotropy, texture-coordinate layer, coordinate interpolation, and map-prefixed internal parameter names.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs to expose or tune sampling behavior for a TOP used by a MAT or shader parameter.
Open the texture-sampling parameters with the + button next to a TOP-sampling parameter.
Internal parameter names are prefixed by the owning map parameter, so the colormap Extend U parameter becomes colormapextendu.
Use extendu, extendv, and extendw for coordinate wrap behavior, with extendw only relevant to 3D Texture sampling.
Use filter, anisotropy, coord, and coordinterp to control filtering quality, texture-coordinate set, and interpolation behavior.
